About Rae Tech Services

We build intuitive, powerful tools designed to elevate human potential and simplify everyday commerce.

At Rae Tech Services, we believe technology should be accessible, beautiful, and deeply useful. Founded with a vision to develop impactful African software, we focus on search engine discovery for enterprises, peer-to-peer campus commerce, and intelligent productivity assistants.
